# Game Idea: Canvas Runner

A side‑scrolling endless runner where the player controls a character that automatically moves forward on a simple 2‑D canvas. The player taps/clicks to make the character jump over incoming obstacles (spikes, pits, moving enemies). Collect coins for score. **Lose condition:** the game ends when the character collides with any obstacle or falls into a pit.

The mechanics are easy to implement with `requestAnimationFrame`, simple rectangle collision detection, and keyboard/mouse input, making it ideal for a quick HTML canvas prototype.

1: // Canvas Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Assumes an existing <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return; // safety
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // ----- Audio setup -----
9:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
10:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
11:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
12:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.connect(gain);
17:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:   };
22:   // Set a default size if not configured in HTML/CSS
23:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
24:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 400;
25: 
26:   // ---------- Game objects ----------
27:   const player = {
28:     x: 50,
29:     y: 0,
30:     w: 30,
31:     h: 50,
32:     vy: 0,
33:     jumpForce: -12,
34:     grounded: false,
35:   };
36: 
37:   const obstacles = [];
38:   const obstacleSpeed = 4;
39:   let lastSpawn = 0;
40:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
41: 
42:   let score = 0;
43:   let gameOver = false;
44: 
45:   // ---------- Utility ----------
46:   const rectsCollide = (a, b) =>
47:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
48: 
49:   let audioStarted = false;
50:   const jump = () => {
51:     if (!audioStarted) {
52:       audioCtx.resume();
53:       audioStarted = true;
54:     }
55:     // Jump sound
56:     playTone(440, 0.08);
57:     if (player.grounded) {
58:       player.vy = player.jumpForce;
59:       player.grounded = false;
60:     }
61:   };
62:     if (player.grounded) {
63:       player.vy = player.jumpForce;
64:       player.grounded = false;
65:     }
66:   };
67: 
68:   // Input (mouse/touch or Space key)
69:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', jump);
70:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); jump(); });
71:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') jump(); });
72: 
73:   // ---------- Visual helpers ----------
74:   const drawBackground = () => {
75:     // Sky gradient
76:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
77:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // sky blue
78:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#b0e0e6'); // pale blue
79:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
80:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
81:   };
82: 
83:   const drawGround = () => {
84:     const groundY = canvas.height - player.h;
85:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321'; // brown ground
86:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, canvas.width, canvas.height - groundY);
87:     // optional line at ground top
88:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
89:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
90:     ctx.beginPath();
91:     ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
92:     ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, groundY);
93:     ctx.stroke();
94:   };
95: 
96:   const drawRoundedRect = (x, y, w, h, r, fillStyle) => {
97:     ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
100:     ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
101:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
102:     ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
103:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
104:     ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
105:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
106:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
107:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
108:     ctx.closePath();
109:     ctx.fill();
110:   };
111: 
112:   // ---------- Game loop ----------
113:   const loop = timestamp => {
114:     if (gameOver) {
115:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
116:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
117:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
118:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
119:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
120:       ctx.fillText(`Game Over – Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
121:       return;
122:     }
123:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
124: 
125:     // Clear and draw background
126:     drawBackground();
127:     drawGround();
128: 
129:     // Player physics
130:     const gravity = 0.5;
131:     player.vy += gravity;
132:     player.y += player.vy;
133:     // Ground check
134:     const groundY = canvas.height - player.h;
135:     if (player.y > groundY) {
136:       player.y = groundY;
137:       player.vy = 0;
138:       player.grounded = true;
139:     }
140: 
141:     // Draw player with rounded corners
142:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, 6, '#0a74da');
143: 
144:     // Spawn obstacles
145:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
146:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
147:       const height = 30 + Math.random() * 40; // 30‑70px tall
148:       obstacles.push({
149:         x: canvas.width,
150:         y: canvas.height - height,
151:         w: 20,
152:         h: height,
153:       });
154:     }
155: 
156:     // Update and draw obstacles
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
158:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
159:       const obs = obstacles[i];
160:       obs.x -= obstacleSpeed;
161:       // Draw obstacle with rounded corners and gradient
162:       const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(obs.x, obs.y, obs.x, obs.y + obs.h);
163:       obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#c0392b');
164:       obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#e74c3c');
165:       drawRoundedRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h, 4, obsGrad);
166: 
167: 
168:       // Collision
169:       if (rectsCollide(player, obs)) {
170:         // Collision sound
171:         playTone(150, 0.2);
172:         gameOver = true;
173:       }
174: 
175:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles and increase score
176:       if (obs.x + obs.w < 0) {
177:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
178:         score++;
179:       }
180:     }
181: 
182:     // Draw score
183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
184:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
185:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}` , 10, 20);
186:   };
187: 
188:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
189: })();

(End of file - total 189 lines)
</content>
